purpose: development learning across varied spatial crops; not production release
initialization: fresh zero-head ACESModel, channels8, pixel_rms v3
sampling: uniform image;25% highlight,25% shadow,50% uniform spatial locations
evaluation: fixed final300 checkpoint, full-frame untiled FP32; compare analytic inverse on same development targets

development_acceptance.highlight_and_shadow_target_mse: no worse than analytic, equal-image means on nonempty supports
development_acceptance.visual: required; no introduced colour streaks or obvious reconstruction seams

limitations: development validation has been used in prior research; target quality is experimental; not independent release, temporal, platform, headroom, or deployment evidence
